reason: I have a pile of money sitting in an SBI NRO account I never log into, and I'd happily pay a few hundred dollars not to deal with forms, a CA and time zones. Fee only when the money lands plus a refund guarantee makes it low-risk to try.
objection: What if the transfer gets stuck halfway or the CA rejects something, and I'm left chasing it on my own with my money in limbo?
would_change_my_mind: If I couldn't confirm the FINTRAC registration and the named partner bank, or if the CA call turned up a big tax hit or hidden extra charges.
